owners.title: Supply remaining filesystem environments after touch creation qualification
owners.prerequisite: Supply each explicit remaining capability and oracle in tests/host_filesystem_residuals.json; preserve CSH-072/CSH-080/CSH-084/CSH-085/CSH-086/CSH-087/CSH-088/CSH-089 selected assertions, call-site fault boundaries and immutable evidence. Private graphs, numeric magic rules and subsecond timestamps do not supply privileged mounts, capacity, ACLs or whole utility contracts. CSH-088 measured ls metadata and exact find timestamps qualify only their authored inputs. CSH-089 adds bounded recursive negative and nested decisions with a pinned rm parent-prompt repair; arbitrary graphs and depth/mount/locale environments remain open. CSH-090 supplies 32 total pathname byte assertions: the selected filesystem PATH_MAX and portable 256-byte limit, operand lengths limit-1, limit and limit+1 (the limit includes NUL), plus diagnostic continuation across two invalid operands and a valid missing operand. Independent pathconf and unnormalized stat probes distinguish kernel ENAMETOOLONG from the portable policy. Components are at most two bytes; no deep tree or filesystem exhaustion is exercised. CSH-091 supplies 32 physical pwd assertions after renaming the current directory or its parent, and after removing the current directory alone or together with its parent. The helper independently checks unchanged cwd device/inode, absence of the old pathname, and exact getcwd resolution or ENOENT before exec. Both option forms end in -P. No PWD assignment, logical-mode, arbitrary race, permission, path-limit, allocation or stdio-error qualification is claimed. CSH-092 supplies 104 final creation-mode assertions for mkdir and mkfifo under independently proved child-only masks 027, 077 and 777. Explicit symbolic removal, sequential copies, conditional execute, existing-middle continuation and bounded mkdir -p graphs are covered. Transient permissions, further mode/graph combinations, ACL inheritance, identities, path limits and capacity exhaustion remain unqualified. CSH-093 supplies 32 external pwd output-error assertions on macOS and 56 pathname utility assertions on Linux: closed stdout EBADF and readerless-pipe EPIPE for pwd -P, -L, -L -P and -P -L, plus Linux virtual-device ENOSPC for those forms and basename/dirname. PWD is unset, so logical forms fall back to the physical cwd. Child-only kernel probes precede exact provider exec. These cases do not supply libc-internal faults, actual filesystem exhaustion, logical namespace changes or arbitrary output failures. CSH-096 supplies 40 touch calendar cases / 160 assertions for the Epoch, two-digit years 70/99/00/68, omitted seconds, leap day, second-60 year rollover, the required January 2038 date and the signed-32-bit timestamp boundary. Integer UTC calendar arithmetic supplies expected timestamps; exact target and unequal fractional baselines are independently read back on the target inode before execution. Default, -a, -m and explicit -a -m selections require exact timestamps, empty channels, zero status and unchanged content. Other date/timezone forms, current-time tolerances, unsupported timestamp errors, arbitrary symlink graphs and permission/ACL boundaries remain unqualified. CSH-097 supplies 28 touch reference cases / 112 assertions for distinct access/modification timestamps, regular and symlink-chain references, hard-linked and symlink-chain operands, all four field selections, and silent -c continuation past missing/dangling paths. Exact nanoseconds and inode relationships are independently probed before execution; post-exec metadata is captured before content reads. Reference files, link texts, inode identities and unselected fields must remain unchanged. Arbitrary graphs, creation/current-time tolerances, unsupported timestamps, races and permission/ACL errors remain unqualified. CSH-108 supplies 60 mkdir -p cases / 240 assertions for shared parents, repeated operands, existing directory symlinks and continuation after regular-file or dangling-symlink prefix obstructions. Literal final and intermediate modes under independently proved child-only masks 027, 077 and 777 cover default, numeric, empty and copy-assignment modes. Existing directory, file and link identities/modes and contents are preserved; output, status, effects and cleanup are required. Further mode/parent graphs, special bits, transient permissions, ACL inheritance, other identities, path/depth limits, namespace races and capacity exhaustion remain unqualified. CSH-109 supplies 19 rmdir cases / 76 assertions for parent chains, explicit child-first and sibling-before-parent operands, shared parents, duplicate operands, nonempty file/link/FIFO ancestors and continuation after missing/file/symlink operands. Private owner-mode write/search denial is independently proved by rmdir returning EACCES before provider exec. Exact removed paths and preserved identities, modes, bytes and links, channels/status and cleanup are required. Arbitrary parent graphs, ACLs and other identities, mount boundaries, total depth/path limits, namespace races, other filesystem failures and diagnostic locales remain unqualified. CSH-110 supplies 29 ln cases / 116 assertions for directory and directory-symlink destinations, literal symbolic-link contents, explicit -L/-P precedence for valid/dangling source links, physical links to directory symlinks, and continuation past missing sources and existing file/link/dangling/FIFO/directory destinations. Forced replacement and same-entry refusal require exact inode relationships, link counts, preserved identities/modes/bytes, channels, status and cleanup. The selected unmodified GNU coreutils 9.7 ln preserves same-entry symbolic sources that Apple ln -fs incorrectly replaces; stock failures remain failures. Further graphs and default-policy alternatives, cross-device and permission/ACL errors, other identities, hard-link count limits, namespace races, filesystem failures, diagnostic locales and resource exhaustion remain unqualified. Directory hard-link behavior and destinations created earlier in the same invocation are not assigned a portable oracle. CSH-111 supplies 21 ln cases / 84 assertions for denied source search and destination write/search permissions. Independent link, symlink and unlink probes require kernel EACCES under one unprivileged fixture identity before exact provider exec. Hard-link failures continue to later operands; -s with and without -L/-P preserves inaccessible source spellings as literal link contents. Forced replacement failures preserve regular files, symlinks, FIFOs and referents. Inodes, modes, link counts, bytes, channels, status, exec records and cleanup are required. Further graph/default-policy alternatives, cross-device and other permission/ACL errors, other identities, hard-link count limits, namespace races, filesystem failures, diagnostic locales and resource exhaustion remain unqualified. Directory hard-link behavior and destinations created earlier in the same invocation have no portable oracle here. CSH-112 supplies 20 touch cases / 80 assertions for denied ancestor search on existing and missing operands, denied parent write during creation, silent -c suppression, and explicit timestamps on owned non-writable files. All four field selections process accessible operands before and after the middle operand. Independent kernel EACCES probes and exact authored timestamp readback precede exact provider exec. Timestamps, inode identities, modes, link counts, bytes, channels, status, exec records and cleanup are required. Other identities and ACLs, current-time and successful-creation tolerances, arbitrary namespace graphs and races, skipped/repeated timezone times, further rules and databases, timestamp ranges, filesystem failures, diagnostic locales and resource exhaustion remain unqualified. CSH-113 supplies 60 touch cases / 240 assertions for current-time existing-file updates, creation and silent -c handling, plus creation with explicit UTC or reference timestamps. All four field selections and child-only masks 027, 077 and 777 require accessible operands before and after the middle operand. Independent kernel creation probes, authored timestamp readback and realtime/monotonic brackets supply the oracles. Current times use a documented one-second lower-bound floor; this is seconds-resolution evidence, not nanosecond accuracy. Exact channels/status, preserved identities/modes/bytes/link counts, created empty-file modes, exec records and cleanup are required. Other identities and ACLs, subsecond current-time accuracy and clock changes, arbitrary namespace graphs and races, skipped/repeated timezone times, further rules and databases, timestamp ranges, filesystem failures, diagnostic locales and resource exhaustion remain unqualified.

owners.title: Qualify host text and byte stream utilities
owners.prerequisite: Supply deterministic byte/text/locale oracles, sparse/large-file fixtures, bounded interrupted I/O, space exhaustion and independent expected offsets. The shared interruption condition also covers ed in CSH-074; coordinate that witness explicitly.

owners.title: Qualify host languages, editors and argument construction
owners.prerequisite: Supply clause-derived programs, regular expressions, editing sessions, patch effects and argument vectors; bound editor temporary-file and signal recovery tests and descendant cleanup.

qualification.scope: Bounded language/editing/regex/patch/argv contracts, private ed/xargs/M4 repairs, SIGINT/SIGHUP recovery and controlled backing-store failures; complete normative pages remain open.

owners.title: Qualify host execution and process utilities
owners.prerequisite: Record the selected /bin/sh ENOEXEC provider independently of PATH sh; supply controlled processes, credentials, loader/resource failures and deterministic clock/timeout controls. Missing timeout remains a provider gap. Do not infer maximum sleep duration by waiting five seconds.

owners.title: Qualify host locale and message catalog utilities
owners.prerequisite: Supply missing catalog providers, generated disposable locales/catalogs and independent encoding/translation expectations. Shared French/German/UTF-8/GB18030 provisioning is owned here; per-utility behavior remains with its named contract owner.

owners.title: Qualify residual terminal and session contracts
owners.prerequisite: Retain the strict CSH-077/081 software witnesses. Supply disposable physical serial hardware and a privileged disposable Darwin VM; complete remaining per-utility locale/signal/I/O/resource and login-record cases in the section map.

owners.title: Qualify host scheduling, mail and service utilities
owners.prerequisite: Supply disposable scheduler, mail transport, print spool and logging services plus controlled time; verify queue/delivery/output effects and cleanup. mailx send mode remains base. Never enqueue jobs, deliver mail or change clocks on the developer host.

U-035/locale-catalogs.boundary: Mode-000 catalog fallback requires independently observed EACCES; root/bypass identities remain explicitly unqualified. Prior search/malformed/set witnesses remain separate; other encodings and installation layouts stay open.

U-035/other-locales.boundary: EUC-JP byte slicing, binary output, literal echo and separately declared Darwin packed/glibc Unicode character constants added. Stateful encodings and other locale families remain open.

U-035/format-allocation-limits.boundary: Source-including probe injects ENOMEM/EINTR/EOVERFLOW/zero-errno vprintf returns with no stream error; this validates adapter propagation, not libc-internal allocator failure. Real Darwin libc exhaustion remains open; earlier Linux RLIMIT_AS evidence stays separate.

U-035/full-format.boundary: Exact rounding, range overflow/underflow with continued output, character constants and numbered precision added. Full-pipe actual caught EINTR/default SIGALRM probes have matching success controls; other interruption points, restart/partial transfer and conversion combinations stay open.

U-036/alternative-policies.boundary: The selected literal provider gains EUC-JP and full-pipe caught EINTR/default SIGALRM probes. No new stock vendor or XSI policy is selected; those require separate identities and oracles.

U-036/argument-limits.boundary: Safe native/Linux thresholds own each child before exec and verify reap/PID disappearance. Ordinary Darwin low-stack calls are rejected before launch. Disposable hosted Darwin 24.6.0 passed four 8 MiB controls then failed at 1 MiB with SIGSEGV; every child was reaped and absent. Other low-stack configurations and original Darwin 23.6.0 stuck-exec/ps failures remain open.
